tooltips.name: OpenCode mode file name (lowercase, hyphens). Maps to .config/opencode/modes/{name}.md
tooltips.temperature: Optional 0.0–2.0 creativity control. Lower = focused, higher = creative
tooltips.tools: JSON object of tool flags, e.g. {"write":false,"edit":false,"bash":false}. Empty = all tools enabled.
tooltips.body: System prompt (markdown after YAML frontmatter). Frontmatter is Name/Model/Temperature/Tools — Lexical only receives the prompt body. Pasting a full mode .md strips --- yaml --- automatically.
